# Create HUD Text

Source: [wiki article 4343](../archive/4343.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create HUD Text](../../api/actions/create-hud-text.md).

<a id="wiki-4343-n1"></a>

- HUD text persists until destroyed, exposes Last Text ID, and creation fails at text capacity.

<a id="wiki-4343-n2"></a>

- Higher sort order appears after lower sort order in the same screen location; reevaluation and spectator visibility are explicit settings.
